adc_averaging.docs:
**integer**: Selects ADC sample averaging count. Defaults to `128`. Valid values are `1`, `4`, `16`, `64`, `128`, `256`, `512`, `1024`.

*See also: [INA2xx family of digital power monitors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina2xx#configuration-variables)*

adc_range.docs:
**`0` or `1`**: Selects the range for differential input across shunt resistor. `0` for ±163.84 mV, `1` for ±40.96 mV range. Defaults to `0`.

*See also: [INA2xx family of digital power monitors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina2xx#configuration-variables)*

bus_voltage.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: Conversion time for bus voltage measurement.

*See also: [INA2xx family of digital power monitors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina2xx#configuration-variables)*

shunt_voltage.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: Conversion time for shunt voltage measurement.

*See also: [INA2xx family of digital power monitors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina2xx#configuration-variables)*

temperature.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: Conversion time for temperature measurement.

*See also: [INA2xx family of digital power monitors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina2xx#configuration-variables)*

adc_time.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The time in microseconds to perform a single ADC conversion. Defaults to `4120 us`. Valid values are `50 us`, `84 us`, `150 us`, `280 us`, `540 us`, `1052 us`, `2074 us`, `4120 us`. Instead of one time for all ADC measurements, separate configuration of conversion times for shunt voltage, bus voltage, and temperature measurements possible. Options are the same as for `adc_time`.

*See also: [INA2xx family of digital power monitors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina2xx#configuration-variables)*

bus_voltage.docs:
Bus voltage output, V

*See also: [INA2xx family of digital power monitors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina2xx#configuration-variables)*

charge.docs:
Calculated charge output, Ah (*INA228/229 only*)

*See also: [INA2xx family of digital power monitors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina2xx#configuration-variables)*

charge_coulombs.docs:
Calculated charge output, Coulombs (*INA228/229 only*)

*See also: [INA2xx family of digital power monitors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina2xx#configuration-variables)*

current.docs:
Calculated current output, A

*See also: [INA2xx family of digital power monitors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina2xx#configuration-variables)*

energy.docs:
Calculated energy output, Wh (*INA228/229 only*)

*See also: [INA2xx family of digital power monitors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina2xx#configuration-variables)*

energy_joules.docs:
Calculated energy output, Joules (*INA228/229 only*)

*See also: [INA2xx family of digital power monitors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina2xx#configuration-variables)*

max_current.docs:
**float**: The maximum current you are expecting. Component will use it to calibrate the sensor. No default value.

*See also: [INA2xx family of digital power monitors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina2xx#configuration-variables)*

power.docs:
Calculated power output, always positive, W

*See also: [INA2xx family of digital power monitors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina2xx#configuration-variables)*

reset_on_boot.docs:
**boolean**: Whether or not to reset the device configuration (including counters) on component initialization. Defaults to `true`; set `false` to preserve counters through ESPHome resets.

*See also: [INA2xx family of digital power monitors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina2xx#configuration-variables)*

shunt_resistance.docs:
**float**: The value of the shunt resistor used for current calculation. No default value.

*See also: [INA2xx family of digital power monitors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina2xx#configuration-variables)*

shunt_voltage.docs:
Differential voltage measured across the shunt, mV

*See also: [INA2xx family of digital power monitors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina2xx#configuration-variables)*

temperature.docs:
Internal die temperature measurement, °C

*See also: [INA2xx family of digital power monitors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina2xx#configuration-variables)*

temperature_coefficient.docs:
**integer from `0` to `16383`**: Temperature coefficient (ppm/°C) of the shunt for temperature compensation correction. Only applicable to INA228 and INA229 devices. Zero value means no compensation is done. Defaults to `0`.

*See also: [INA2xx family of digital power monitors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina2xx#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [INA2xx family of digital power monitors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ina2xx#configuration-variables)*
